items.title: Fairbuds 2 leak gives us an early look at a very different design
items.summary: Fairphone is changing the formula, but hopefully not the best aspect.
items.body: TL;DR Leaked images show the Fairbuds 2 adopting a stem-style design and a taller charging case. Fairphone says the earbuds will remain modular, but it hasn’t specified which parts will be replaceable. Pricing and full specs are still unknown, with the Fairbuds 2 set to launch in Q4 2026. Wireless earbuds aren’t exactly famous for being repair-friendly, which is why Fairphone’s first Fairbuds were such an oddity. You could replace parts instead of binning the whole thing when something wore out. Now the Fairbuds 2 have leaked, and their new design has raised the question of whether that repairability has survived. Dutch outlet NieuweMobiel has obtained images of the upcoming Fairbuds 2, which Fairphone has already confirmed will launch in Q4 2026. The new buds ditch the rounded shape of the originals for a stem-style design, while the charging case is taller. The images show green and black versions, which mirror the Forest Green and Horizon Black colorways of the new Fairphone Gen 6 Plus .

items.title: Building websites with ChatGPT just got faster and more collaborative
items.summary: ChatGPT Sites is done making you build everything by yourself.
items.body: TL;DR ChatGPT Sites’ new Build Together feature lets multiple people edit, save, and publish the same Site. Sites can now stay private and be shared with specific people, and deployment is roughly twice as fast. ChatGPT can now inspect a Site’s database, and Sites also support custom domains. ChatGPT seems to get a new feature every other day. This time, OpenAI is turning its attention to ChatGPT Sites , which launched about three months ago and lets you create, host, and share websites and lightweight web apps just by describing what you want. Until now, though, building one was mostly a solo affair. That’s changing with a new feature called Build Together, which lets you invite other people to work on the same Site. They can edit, save, and publish changes themselves, which should make the whole process much easier for teams. Say you’re putting together a website for a small event or building a quick tool for work. Instead of one person making every change while everyone else sends suggestions back and forth, everyone can jump in and work on it directly.

items.body: If you’re planning to watch the 2026 Primetime Emmys on Monday (Sept. 14), brace yourself for a long (but likely highly entertaining) segment when they hand out the award for outstanding variety series. Thanks to a rule change this year, there could be multiple winners in that category. Beginning this year, the Television Academy combined best scripted variety series and best talk series into a single category: best variety series. The academy also converted it to what they call “an area award,” which means the nominees aren’t directly competing against each other. Instead, voters answer one question for each nominated show: “Does this nominee merit an Emmy?” Any series that receives at least 90% “yes” votes is awarded an Emmy. (If no nominee meets that threshold, the show with the highest approval percentage takes the trophy.) items.title: Google Health no longer lets users log in with Fitbit
items.summary: To be fair, we've known this was coming for years now.
items.body: TL;DR Google Health version 5.08 has removed the option to log in using Fitbit account credentials. Google has been warning this would happen since 2022. Data that hasn’t been migrated from legacy Fitbit accounts to Google accounts will be deleted. Google acquired Fitbit in 2021. It’s been warning users since 2022 that, eventually, accessing Fitbit — since renamed Google Health — would require using a Google account. The company’s given us a lot of runway to migrate our data, even pushing back the deadline early this year . But that extended deadline came and went in May, and now, Google has removed the option to log into Google Health with legacy Fitbit account credentials. The announcement came by way of some very sparse update notes for Google Health version 5.08 . The latest version of the app fixes some bugs, but the primary change is that now, you can only log in using your Google account. Google also says that data that hasn’t been migrated from legacy Fitbit accounts to current Google accounts “will be deleted.”

items.title: Meta’s Project Phoenix just leaked, and it looks nothing like a Quest
items.summary: Project Phoenix looks ready to make bulky headsets feel very yesterday.
items.body: TL;DR Images found inside Meta’s HorizonOS Prescription Lens app appear to reveal the rumored Project Phoenix headset ahead of Meta Connect on September 23. Phoenix looks more like chunky glasses than a traditional Quest headset, with glasses-style nose pads, sensors around the temples, and a separate compute puck. We still haven’t seen Phoenix properly from the front or on someone’s face, leaving big questions about its size, appearance, and overall design. Meta Connect kicks off on September 23, and we may have just gotten an early peek at one of the more interesting devices Meta could be preparing to talk about. UploadVR has spotted images of Meta’s rumored Project Phoenix headset inside the HorizonOS Prescription Lens app. While they don’t show the full device, they reveal enough to suggest Phoenix won’t be another Quest-style headset . Instead, Meta appears to be going for something much slimmer. From the angles shown, Phoenix looks more like chunky glasses than a conventional VR headset. Nose pads hold the device in place, while what appear to be sensors sit around the temples. The overall look immediately reminds me of XREAL Aura glasses , which use a similar setup.

items.summary: ماذا قال المدرب الهولندي بعد الفوز على الحزم؟
items.body: ماذا قال المدرب الهولندي بعد الفوز على الحزم؟ أثنى الهولندي مارينو بوسيتش، المدير الفني لفريق الأهلي، على لاعبيه، بعد الفوز على الحزم في دوري روشن السعودي. وفاز الأهلي على الحزم بنتيجة 3-1، خلال المباراة التي جمعت بينهما، مساء الجمعة ، على ملعب الإنماء بجدة، في الجولة السابعة من دوري روشن. وقال بوسيتش في تصريحات بالمؤتمر الصحفي بعد المباراة نقلتها صحيفة "الشرق الأوسط" السعودية : "بدأنا المباراة ونحن مصدومون من الهدف الأول، لكنني سعيد بأهدافنا وتحكمنا في مجريات اللقاء بمجرد أن عادلنا النتيجة". ونجح الحزم في تسجيل الهدف الأول في شباك الأهلي بعد مرور 87 ثانية فقط، قبل أن ينجح "الراقي" في قلب النتيجة لصالحه، بتسجيل 3 أهداف قبل نهاية الشوط الأول. وأضاف المدرب الهولندي: "أود أن أشكر اللاعبين، فقد صنعنا العديد من الفرص في الشوط الثاني، وأعتقد أن فريقي يستحق التقدير على ما قدمه اليوم، حيث أظهرنا عودة رائعة وجودة عالية من الناحية الكروية". يُذكر أن الفوز رفع رصيد الأهلي إلى 12 نقطة، حصدها من 4 انتصارات و3 هزائم، يحتل بها المركز الخامس في جدول ترتيب الدوري السعودي، بفارق 5 نقاط خلف جاره وغريمه التقليدي الاتحاد الذي يحتل الصدارة بشكل مؤقت. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشترِ تذكرتك الآنَ!

items.body: المهاجم الإنجليزي كان قريبًا من إنجاز غير مسبوق حرم خطأ تحكيمي، الإنجليزي إيفان توني مهاجم الأهلي، من تسجيل هاتريك تاريخي في شباك الحزم بدوري روشن السعودي. وفاز الأهلي على الحزم بنتيجة 3-1، خلال المباراة التي جمعت بينهما، اليوم الجمعة ، على ملعب الإنماء بجدة، في الجولة السابعة من دوري روشن. وشهدت المباراة تألق المهاجم الإنجليزي إيفان توني ، حيث سجل هدفين، أحدهما من ركلة جزاء حصل عليها بنفسه، كما أهدر ركلة أخرى كان سببًا فيها أيضًا. الخبير التحكيمي محمد كمال ريشة أكد أن توني استحق الحصول على ركلة جزاء ثالثة، قبل نحو 10 دقائق فقط من نهاية المباراة، غير أن الحكم لم يحتسبها. توني يسقط ويطالب بوجود ركلة جزاء ⚠️ #الأهلي_الحزم | #دوري_روشن_السعودي pic.twitter.com/81sVzeYfbk — رياضة ثمانية (@thmanyahsports) September 11, 2026 وقال ريشة في تصريحات لصحيفة "الرياضية" السعودية: "هناك ركلة جزاء غير محتسبة للأهلي في الدقيقة 81". وأوضح: "إيفان توني تعرض للجذب من موري كوناتيه، لاعب الحزم، وتوجُّه الحكم إلى شاشة الفار للمراجعة وعودته دون احتسابها قرار خاطئ". محمد كمال ريشة، المحلل التحكيمي لـ «الرياضية»: «ركلة جزاء غير محتسبة للأهلي في الدقيقة 81.. إيفان توني تعرض للجذب من موري كوناتيه، لاعب الحزم، وتوجُّه الحكم إلى شاشة VAR للمراجعة وعودته دون احتسابها قرار خاطئ». #الأهلي_الحزم #دوري_روشن_ا…

items.title: Lenovo Googlebook 15 specs leak, and this clearly isn’t your schoolhouse Chromebook
items.summary: Despie the close Android integration.
items.body: TL;DR Lenovo’s upcoming Googlebook 15 has reportedly leaked in full, revealing a 15.3-inch 120Hz OLED display, Intel Core Ultra 5 325 chip, and up to 32GB of RAM. The laptop could also feature a 70Wh battery, Wi-Fi 7, dual Thunderbolt 4 ports, HDMI, a fingerprint reader, and a Google-colored battery/charging light on the lid. Googlebook OS will put Gemini Intelligence and Android phone integration front and center, while Lenovo is also preparing a dedicated Google key and an “AI Mouse” accessory. Earlier in May this year, Google introduced its Googlebook laptop category. These are laptops designed from the ground up for Gemini Intelligence, with Google aiming to create a PC experience that offers premium hardware, works seamlessly with Android phones, and puts AI features front and center. Now, a new leak has revealed just how serious that ambition could be. There’s no Googlebook out just yet, but we know that multiple companies are actively developing them, with Lenovo among them. We’ve seen renders of its upcoming Lenovo Googlebook 15 in the past, and now a fresh leak appears to reveal nearly everything else about the machine.

Tim Cook from Palmerston North.” As was long rumored, Apple officially entered the foldable race this week after announcing the iPhone Duo . Similar to the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Apple’s new form factor sports a wide, passport-like design. Not missing a beat, Samsung took the opportunity to poke some fun at the Cupertino-based firm. Samsung’s New Zealand branch has shared a playful new advertisement for the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The video stars “Tim Cook” endorsing the iPhone Duo rival. Not that Tim Cook, but Tim Cook from Palmerston North, New Zealand. However, this Tim Cook does look an awful lot like Apple’s former CEO, sporting glasses and clothing that are similar in style to what the executive is known to wear.

items.summary: هل يتفوق على البرغوث؟
items.body: هل يتفوق على البرغوث؟ علق الفرنسي كيليان مبابي، مهاجم ريال مدريد ، عن مقارنة نفسه بليونيل ميسي، أسطورة برشلونة ومنتخب الأرجنتين. وسئل مبابي، في حوار أجراه مع صحيفة "ليكيب" الفرنسية ، عن رؤية نفسه يلعب في سن 39 مثل ليونيل ميسي، ورد قائلا: "أرى نفسي ألعب حتى أصل إلى 100 عاما إذا لزم الأمر! (يضحك)". وأضاف: "هل سأكون بنفس الجودة؟ هذه مسألة ذكاء: أن تعرف متى لم يعد بإمكانك الاستمرار. ميسي لم يضطر لطرح هذا السؤال على نفسه لأنه لا يزال قادرا. بعد ذلك، ليونيل ميسي هو ليونيل ميسي. وأنا أعتبر نفسي لاعبا مختلفا. لكنه أحد هؤلاء اللاعبين المختلفين". وحول ما ينتظره من جوزيه مورينيو مدرب ريال مدريد، قال: "ببساطة أن يجعلني ألعب. (يضحك). بعد ذلك، أعتقد أنني قادر على التأقلم مع بقية الأمور. ليس لدي توقعات خاصة. أن يكون نفسه فهذا يكفي تماما". وسئل مبابي إذا كان يتخيل إنهاء مسيرته من دون الفوز بدوري أبطال أوروبا أو الكرة الذهبية، وأجاب: "نعم. الفوز يتحقق في الملعب. حسنا، الكرة الذهبية تعتمد أيضا على التصويت. لكن قبل النظر إلى ما سيحدث بعد عشرة أعوام، يجب النظر إلى ما يحدث الآن. أملك هذا العام فرصة كبيرة للفوز بالكرة الذهبية". يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة"

items.body: Poynting crater and Keeler crater are visible side by side in the lower right portion of this image of the Moon’s far side highlands. Poynting, positioned above, is a large impact crater with a well-defined rim and relatively smooth interior, indicative of material that has settled following the initial impact. Just below it, Keeler crater appears slightly smaller, with a sharply outlined rim and a more textured interior shaped by subsequent impacts and ejecta. Both features lie within the densely cratered far side highlands, preserving a record of ancient impacts that have shaped the lunar surface over billions of years. items.title: I tried out the Pixel 11 Pro Fold and Google still can’t convince me to buy a foldable
items.summary: The Pixel 11 Pro Fold is better than ever. But is it finally worth it? Ehh...
items.body: It’s been a while since I last used a book-style foldable . My previous dalliance was the OPPO Find N2 back in 2022, and while I was impressed by how far the form factor had already come, I ultimately didn’t see enough reason to make the switch. Like many other potential converts, the drawbacks simply weren’t worth the small benefits. Four years on, I’m back to find out whether things have finally changed with the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold. I’ve spent plenty of time with Pixel Pro flagships in the intervening years and have generally been a fan of Google’s software, cameras, and even some of its latest AI-focused approaches. But does that familiar Pixel formula work when you double the screen and fold the whole thing in half? More importantly, has the foldable finally become something I actually want to use every day?

items.summary: Finally, someone else can figure out what those numbers actually mean.
items.body: TL;DR Gemini is coming to Google Sheets on Android, letting you analyze spreadsheet data directly from your phone. You can ask Gemini to summarize tables, spot trends and insights, and create charts without manually digging through rows of data. More complex tasks like generating formulas and advanced formatting still require the web version. Working with a spreadsheet on your phone usually isn’t much fun. The screen is smaller, navigating a table can be annoying, and figuring out what hundreds of rows of numbers mean can become a job better saved for your laptop. Now, Google is trying to make that a little less painful by bringing Gemini in Google Sheets to Android. Gemini can now analyze the spreadsheet you have open and answer questions about the data directly from your phone. You can tap the Gemini sparkle icon inside the Sheets app and ask it to summarize a table, look for interesting patterns, or pull out useful insights.

The feature is coming globally to most smart TVs, streaming devices, and game consoles. YouTube recently made watching videos on a TV less of a remote-control chore. Its new companion experience lets your phone handle searches, comments, and other fiddly tasks without interrupting whatever is playing on the big screen. Now, YouTube is giving that phone another useful job: unlocking your profile while keeping everyone else on the couch out of it. YouTube has announced a new account lock feature for its TV app. It lets you protect an individual account with a four-digit code, preventing other people who share the TV from opening your profile and poking around your recommendations, subscriptions, or search history.

items.title: The iPhone 18 Pro camera is already years behind 2026 Android phones
items.summary: The iPhone 18 Pro's variable aperture camera sounds impressive, but it's not enough for me.
items.body: Much of this week’s talk about Apple’s new releases centers on the brand’s first foldable—the iPhone Duo . But as a practical individual, I imagine a lot more consumers will be looking at the iPhone 18 Pro series and pondering whether there’s enough new hardware to justify the price hikes. While there are some key tweaks to processing power and new camera software tools, the iPhone’s latest innovation is a return to variable-aperture technology, ranging from f/1.48 to f/4, that Android rivals trialed and abandoned years ago. If this is seriously the best Apple can do to catch up with China’s best camera phones, I can’t see serious photographers like myself rushing to switch to the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max.

items.title: Android just made switching password managers a whole lot safer and easier
items.summary: Your passwords finally get a safer ride to their new home.
items.body: TL;DR Android is making it easier and safer to move passwords and passkeys between supported password managers. The new system removes the need to export your password vault as a potentially unencrypted file and manually import it elsewhere. Password transfers currently work with Google Password Manager, 1Password, Bitwarden, and Dashlane, with more services coming later. Passwords are basically the keys to our digital lives. They protect everything from our emails and social media accounts to banking apps and personal photos, so the last thing you want is to accidentally leave them exposed. Unfortunately, that can become a concern when you decide to switch password managers. Right now, you may have to export your entire vault as a file, save it to your device, and then import it into your new password manager . Worse, that exported file can be unencrypted, which means all those usernames and passwords you’ve spent years protecting could temporarily sit together in a regular file on your phone. You also have to remember to delete it once you’re done.

Fitness trackers have happily told us how much we moved, how poorly we slept, and how fast our hearts beat, then largely left us to connect the dots. But Whoop and Oura changed that by turning a pile of biometric data into one digestible answer: Should you push hard today or take it easy? At its big iPhone launch event , Apple finally brought that idea to the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 with a new feature called Readiness. Readiness combines recent activity and vitals, including sleep duration, blood oxygen, HRV, respiratory rate, and resting heart rate, into a score from zero to ten. Apple then translates that number into one of four refreshingly direct recommendations: Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready, or Go For It. The idea is to help you decide whether today calls for a demanding workout, a lighter session, or perhaps no heroics at all.

items.title: Two phones, one number: Apple just beat Android to a very handy feature
items.summary: iPhone Handoff sounds great for dual-phone users, if your carrier supports it.
items.body: Credit: Aamir Siddiqui / Android Authority TL;DR Apple has given more details about iPhone Handoff ahead of the iOS 27 launch. The feature lets supported users switch between two iPhones while keeping the same phone number. It launches with T-Mobile in the US and Telekom Germany, with wider carrier support expected later. If you regularly carry two phones , Apple just removed one of the biggest annoyances that comes with it. iOS 27 officially introduces iPhone Handoff, letting you switch between two iPhones while keeping the same phone number. Apple confirmed the feature today as part of its iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo announcements. The company says iPhone Handoff will allow users with supported carriers to “easily switch back and forth between two iPhone models with the same phone number.” iOS 27 rolls out next week on September 14.

items.title: Apple Watch can now rewind your conversations, and that’s kinda creepy
items.summary: Smart glasses, meet your creepy new competition.
items.body: TL;DR Apple’s new Live Rewind feature can show a text snippet of what was said during the previous 15 seconds. A double-press of the Digital Crown activates it, while Siri can answer questions about the captured text or save it for later. Apple has added visible and audible privacy safeguards, but a watch that can recall what was just said may still feel unsettling. Wouldn’t it be a little creepy if I told you the watch on your wrist could rewind the last 15 seconds of your life? Well, that’s essentially what Apple’s new Live Rewind feature can do. Apple announced the feature alongside the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 today, and despite the slightly creepy premise, it’s easy to imagine situations where it could be genuinely useful. Maybe someone rattled off a Wi-Fi password too quickly, you missed an important number during a conversation, or a colleague said something in a meeting, and you only realized five seconds later that you should probably have been paying attention.
